purpose: Independent primary-source spot checks for revised Rust ORM database design; not product verification or GitHub user approval.

claims.claim: 2.0.4 pins Rust edition 2024, rust-version 1.94.0; optional sqlx/sqlx-core 0.9.0, sea-query ~1.0.0, sea-query-sqlx 0.9. Crate constraints still require actual Cargo.lock for product reproducibility.
claims.limits: Source dependency declarations only; no lock resolution/build executed.

claims.claim: ActiveValue represents Set/Unchanged/NotSet; try_set returns type error whereas set may panic. insert/update execute DB before after_save. save selects insert/update based on primary-key presence.
claims.limits: Other ActiveModel relationships and full update implementation not read here; no guarantee hooks are transactionally atomic by themselves.

claims.claim: DatabaseTransaction owns private Arc<Mutex<InnerConnection>>. Consuming commit/rollback clear open only after success; Drop queues rollback and expects start_rollback success. Busy connection lock makes start_rollback error; stream holds lock guard. Built-in wrapper does not directly expose per-connection discard/progress ownership to external FFI host.
claims.limits: Remaining transaction execution methods not independently reread; source inference is reason to use public traits with own SessionExecutor, not a defect claim against safe SeaORM callers.

claims.claim: Public unsealed ConnectionTrait/StreamTrait permit owned SessionExecutor adapter. TransactionTrait's associated transaction recursively implements TransactionTrait plus TransactionSession; savepoint/nested semantics must be explicit.
claims.limits: Proposed NativeWeave implementation not compiled; trait compatibility still requires real build tests.

claims.claim: Public From<SqliteRow> for QueryResult and From<SqliteQueryResult> for ExecResult support external adapter output. Driver builds query from SqlxValues with AssertSqlSafe. Default query_all uses fetch_all and cannot alone guarantee NativeWeave byte/row bound.
claims.limits: Driver connection configuration/remaining methods not read here; NW must implement bounded collection using provider primitives.

claims.claim: Select<Entity> owns SeaQuery SelectStatement plus entity marker; joined select variants distinguish optional outer rows and grouped collections.
claims.limits: Builder/executor implementations not read in this reviewer sample; not a complete ORM call-chain coverage claim.

claims.claim: Test inserts a model and streams one returned entity successfully.
claims.limits: Test source read, not run; does not establish cancellation/drain/deadline behavior.

claims.claim: Tests distinguish drop rollback, explicit commit/rollback, nested rollback/commit. before_save error leaves row count 0; after_save error leaves row present inside transaction until transaction cleanup.
claims.limits: Tests read, not run; nested test scope partial; no packet-loss/Unknown/cancellation production proof.

claims.claim: Source tests exercise Rust relation-aware ActiveModel builder and HasOne replacement/clear. Replacement deletes old record; clearing removes it.
claims.limits: Tests read, not run; remainder not inspected. NativeWeave must specify own relationship mutation admission and transaction policy.

notes: SQLx SQLite 0.9.0 source handoff is sqlx09-sqlite-evidence-by-interop.json; the Cargo constraint now matches this source version family, while final product lock/feature/target must still be captured.
No new SeaORM/C#/Rust code was compiled or executed. Other upstream files fetched for location were not counted as read when not inspected.
